title: The Server That's Really Hurting Us
summary: Chidi's dashboard ranks servers by how often they flicker. He thinks that's the whole story.

client.name: Chidi Okafor
brief: kora-1 and lumen-2 are flagged red on my dashboard — they log way more outage events than datacore-3. Management wants me to replace one of them.
But a flicker that clears in two minutes isn't the same as a server that's actually down for an hour and a half. I need the real cost, not the event count.
client.thanks: datacore-3. I'll move the migration there first — three long outages a week is a bigger deal than the dashboard made it look.

starterSql:
-- Which server is actually costing us the most downtime?
-- Careful: more outage events doesn't mean more total time down.

SELECT *
FROM outages
LIMIT 20;

tables.name: outages
tables.description: Every logged outage across the three servers this month, with how long it lasted.

columns.name: duration_minutes
columns.desc: How long it lasted, in minutes

hints.title: Hint 1: An event count isn't downtime
hints.desc: A server with fourteen two-minute blips and a server with three ninety-minute outages can log very different total downtime.

hints.title: Hint 2: Sum the actual minutes
hints.desc: For each server, add up duration_minutes across all its outages.

hints.title: Hint 3: Rank by that total
hints.desc: GROUP BY server, order by total downtime descending, take the top one.

findings.claim: Which server is really costing the most downtime?

options.text: kora-1 — it has the most outage events
datacore-3 — a handful of outages, but they run far longer
lumen-2 — tied with kora-1 for most events

findings.claim: Why did the event-count dashboard point at the wrong server?

options.text: It ranks by number of outages, not how long each one actually lasted.
datacore-3's outages aren't logged at all.
It isn't wrong — kora-1 really is the worst.

successFeedback: kora-1 and lumen-2 log far more outage events, but each one clears in a couple of minutes. datacore-3 rarely goes down, but when it does, it's down for well over an hour — far more total downtime.

fixtures.failHint: Your answer doesn't match the server with the most total downtime here.
A server with few outages can still cost the most downtime. Sum duration_minutes, don't count rows.

fixtures.purpose: A different week where a different server is the real problem
fixtures.failHint: Your query gives the wrong server on a different week's data — it may be hardcoded instead of computing the total.
